name: SNS
recent: SNS Network Technology Berhad 在2026年9月底公布季度业绩，并宣布每股0.25仙的第一次中期股息。公司执行董事 Pah Wai Onn 在11月中旬的闭市期间增持了公司股份。此外，公司秘书于9月底发生变更。
notable: 宣布每股0.25仙的第一次中期股息，除权日为2026年11月4日，派发日为2026年11月26日。
执行董事 Pah Wai Onn 在2026年11月16日至17日期间增持共1,000,400股普通股。
公司秘书 Chong Kwai Yoong 于2026年9月30日变更。
risks: 执行董事 Pah Wai Onn 在闭市期间进行股份交易，需留意后续持股变动。
主要股东 Prudential PLC 和 Eastspring Investments Berhad 近期多次申报持股变动，显示股权结构有所调整。
earnings: 2026财年第二季度（截至7月31日）营收为8.018亿令吉，环比增长80.2%，但同比下降2.5%；净利为1,289万令吉，环比大增376.3%，同比增长25.8%；净利率从上一季度的0.6%提升至1.6%。

recent_en: SNS Network Technology Berhad announced its quarterly results and a first interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share in late September 2026. Executive Director Pah Wai Onn acquired shares during the closed period in mid-November. The company secretary also changed in late September.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 November 2026 and payment date on 26 November 2026.
Executive Director Pah Wai Onn acquired a total of 1,000,400 ordinary shares on 16-17 November 2026.
Change of company secretary to Chong Kwai Yoong on 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director Pah Wai Onn traded shares during the closed period; subsequent changes in holdings should be monitored.
Substantial shareholders Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments Berhad have filed multiple changes in shareholding recently, indicating adjustments in the ownership structure.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was MYR801.8 million, up 80.2% QoQ but down 2.5% YoY; net income was MYR12.89 million, up 376.3% QoQ and 25.8% YoY; net margin improved to 1.6% from 0.6% in the previous quarter.
